# Measure per intent never as one company number

> Measure per intent, never as one company number.


## The heuristic

**Measure per intent, never as one company number.**


_Why:_ A blended rate moves with question mix for reasons unrelated to knowledge quality. Password resets deflect well and always did; a billing dispute never will. Per-intent is the only granularity at which the number is actionable and the only one at which gaming is visible.
